announcement.title: 🎬 Cinematic Cut-ins v2.0.9
announcement.content:
v2.0.9: RSReforged Trigger Fixes

  • Actor Advanced Formula and Dice Check triggers now evaluate RSReforged Quick Rolls after the dice are available, including natural 1 conditions such as d.includes(1).
  • Actor conditions run once per chat card. Rendering the card again does not replay the cut-in or macro.
  • RSReforged critical attacks no longer evaluate item keyword, dice, and formula rules twice, preventing duplicate macro execution.
